analysis.summary: Steel Strips Wheels Limited reported a Q1 FY27 revenue of INR1,509 crores, representing a 27% year-on-year growth driven by healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, and commercial vehicle segments. Standalone EBITDA with other income increased by 32% year-on-year to INR165.17 crores, with EBITDA per wheel rising to INR314 compared to INR262 in Q1 FY26. Management highlighted ongoing capacity expansions in Bhuj, improved export traction due to stabilized global tariff conditions, and solid demand across agricultural and commercial vehicle markets. Looking ahead, the company targets 20% plus top line growth for FY27 while focusing on operational efficiencies and premium product growth. Steel Strips Wheels Limited published its investor presentation for July 2026 detailing operational capacities, product segments, financial performance for Q1 FY27, and historical financials.

guidance.claim: The company is targeting a top line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
guidance.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

guidance.claim: Management aims to increase EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
guidance.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, and commercial vehicle segments, supported by improved domestic demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The quarter witnessed healthy momentum across alloy wheels, tractor wheels, commercial vehicle segments, supported by improved domestic demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The tractor segment continued to perform well, supported by robust rural recovery, the shift towards higher horsepower mechanization, increase in healthy rural cash flows, and stable replacement demand.
demand_outlook.quote: The Tractor segment continued to perform well during this quarter, supported by robust rural recovery, the shift towards higher horsepower mechanization, increase in healthy rural cash flows and stable replacement demand.

demand_outlook.claim: The commercial vehicles segment witnessed gradual improvement supported by replacement demand, infrastructure-led investments, and improving freight movement.
demand_outlook.quote: The Commercial Vehicles segment also witnessed gradual improvement, supported by replacement demand, infrastructure-led investments and improving freight movement.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for exports has started showing recovery, yielding positive results and improved business momentum.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand for the exports have started showing recovery yielding to positive results and improved business momentum.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj, comprising an aluminium wheel plant and an aluminium knuckles facility.
capex_expansion.quote: Now as already conveyed, we are setting up two manufacturing facilities in Bhuj. The first is an aluminium wheel plant with an annual capacity of 1.2 million wheels, while the second is an aluminium knuckles facility with an annual capacity of 1.1 million units.

capex_expansion.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminium segment facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of the current financial year.
capex_expansion.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

capex_expansion.claim: The total planned capex for the Bhuj plant expansion in alloy wheels and knuckles is around INR420 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: Total capex, which we are planning in the current year is from the Bhuj plant where we are expanding our alloy wheel capacity by 1.2 million and knuckles capacity 0.6 million. And the total capex in both these are around INR420 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Net Capex of INR 196 Crs. was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.
capex_expansion.quote: Net Capex of INR 196 Crs. was incurred through FY26 towards incremental capacity expansion, largely focused on aluminium wheels and aluminium knuckles.

margins_costs.claim: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% year-on-year and stood at INR165.17 crores.
margins_costs.quote: Standalone EBITDA with other income for the quarter increased by 32% Y-o-Y and stood at INR165.17 crores.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per wheel for the current quarter stands at INR314 compared to INR262 in Q1 FY26.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA per wheel for current quarter stands at INR314 per wheel as compared to INR262 per wheel in the Quarter 1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: Margin percentages expanded by 40 bps driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix, and cost optimization initiatives.
margins_costs.quote: Margin percentages expanded during the quarter by 40 bps, driven by input increases received from OEMs other than raw materials, operating leverage, a favourable product mix and an increasing share of premium products and continued cost optimization initiatives across manufacturing facilities.

margins_costs.claim: Profit after tax grew 43% year-on-year to INR71.51 crores with the PAT margin improving to 4.7%.
margins_costs.quote: The profit after tax grew 43% Y-o-Y to INR71.51 crores with PAT margin improving to 4.7%.

orders_capacity.claim: The aluminium knuckle business is running at 100% utilization as we speak.
orders_capacity.quote: And within these 2 customers that I talked about earlier, we have got new businesses awarded now, so much so that now we are absolutely running at the moment as we speak at 100% utilization.

orders_capacity.claim: All business units are running at more than 95% utilization.
orders_capacity.quote: If you really ask me, all my business units are running at more than 95% utilization.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has maintained a consistent dividend payout history.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistent Dividend paid by the Company

risks_headwinds.claim: The business continued to demonstrate resilience despite the war in West Asia and volatility in commodity prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite the war in West Asia and the volatility in commodity prices especially, our business has continued to demonstrate resilience across key segments.

risks_headwinds.claim: Manpower challenges experienced during the previous year have now been fully resolved.
risks_headwinds.quote: The manpower challenges experienced during the previous year have now been fully resolved, enabling smoother production planning and better execution.

management_commitments.claim: Trial production at the Bhuj aluminium segment facilities is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We will be at about 6.2 million wheels in the aluminium segment and trial production is expected to commence in the fourth quarter of this current financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company targets a top line growth of 20% plus for FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about our outlook for FY27, targeting a top line growth of 20% plus.

management_commitments.claim: Management remains focused on enhancing profitability by increasing EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: We remain focused on enhancing profitability by increasing our EBITDA per wheel from around INR262 in the previous financial year to more than INR310 through this financial year.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to commercialize the brownfield steel/agricultural wheel expansion before the end of the current calendar year.
management_commitments.quote: I think we are very optimistic to commercialize it before the end of this calendar year, definitely.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
